summary: Accomplished Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of Python experience, 4+ years of TypeScript development, and extensive expertise building AI-integrated applications on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Firestore). Skilled in designing full-stack systems, telemetry data processing with numpy and pandas, and scalable automated testing architectures. Proven mentor with decades of software engineering leadership in Silicon Valley.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Architected full-stack web applications using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Google Cloud infrastructure including Vertex AI, Firestore, and Cloud Storage.
Built the 'Hire Me' AI Tools Suite powered by Vertex AI, featuring automated job-fit scoring, dynamic factual resume generation, and interactive conversational Q&A.
Developed 'Photo Fun', an AI image transformation application integrating Google Gemini, TypeScript, Vite, and Firebase, hosted on Vercel with Vertex AI for production.
Constructed 'Tensor Logic', an interactive educational AI application demonstrating neural and symbolic AI paradigms with a TypeScript/Vite frontend and a Rust/Axum backend on Shuttle.rs.
Created end-to-end testing and verification suites using Vitest and Playwright to maintain high quality and reliability across AI-driven applications.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Developed Python-based verification testing and automation for medical point-of-care diagnostic instruments.
Built comprehensive API reference documentation hosted on internal web infrastructure using a novel Sphinx extension.
Implemented instrument software verification suites comprising 9 USB-based update verification tests and regression testing.
Proposed and designed remote-access continuous integration and real target testing architecture covering all physical interfaces.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Engineered an object-oriented Python test framework mediating between cloud servers and hardware endpoints to verify Over the Air (OTA) firmware updates.
Designed the test framework for high scalability, incorporating three levels of logging and modular, dynamically loaded test procedures.
Implemented real-time concurrent application log monitoring and dual-level stop-on-fail execution controls on Ubuntu Linux.
Created comprehensive YAML configuration files for flexible test suite parameterization and context management of system resources.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Constructed telemetry event log analysis and visualization pipelines using Python, numpy, pandas, and matplotlib across multi-dimensional system status metrics.
Engineered time-series plotting and cross-tabulation tools for telemetry data streams from built-in hardware monitors.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed, cleaned test data correlated synchronously with environmental and system-level test logs in Python.
Wrote digital and analog control software in Python running on Debian Linux across microcomputer test nodes.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Authored custom Python scripts to generate XML timing patterns for high-speed digital instrument calibration.
Designed and implemented timing calibration software in C++ for a 192-channel digital ATE instrument.
Co-designed four distinct applications of a generic parallel, binary search object.

experience.title: Sr. Test Program Engineer
bullets: Developed functional and performance test suites on Linux test platforms with SQL database integration for enterprise SSDs.
Mentored a new college graduate engineer in test development methodologies and Linux scripting practices.

additionalSections.title: Technical Domains & Platforms
additionalSections.content: Deep background across Linux/Unix systems since 1980, server platforms, automated measurement, cloud AI API integration (Google Vertex AI, Google Gemini), data telemetry pipelines, and continuous integration workflows.
